category.description: Poster category: "ten" (Ten Most Wanted Fugitives), "fraudster" (Most Wanted Fraudsters), "kidnapping", "missing" (missing persons), "information" (seeking information), "ecap" (Endangered Child Alert Program), "law-enforcement-assistance", or "default" (general wanted).
